description: Fuji于1984年推出的胶片相机。配备Fujinon 35 mm f/4, 3 elements/3 groups.。快门速度Mechanical shutter coupled to film ISO setting; e.g. locked to 1/100 s with ISO 100 film.。感光度100–200–400 ISO, set manually.。Active infrared autofocus.。

specs.快门: Mechanical shutter coupled to film ISO setting; e.g. locked to 1/100 s with ISO 100 film.
specs.英文简介: The Fuji DL-50, or Fuji Lucia in Japan, is a compact autofocus camera released 1984, to coincide with Fuji's new branding.
